case.title: Bounded Pilot
case.brief: Run another manual, opt-in peer-learning session with existing club permission.
case.goal: Learn whether a small community session is useful.

exhibits.title: Twenty-four participants completed a session. Club permission covers one repeat opt-in session.
exhibits.detail: User supplied; source accuracy is not independently authenticated.

claims.text: One session does not establish sustained long-term demand.
An existing session and permission support one bounded repeat pilot.

sides.statement: Side A challenges the load-bearing assumption.
sides.concession: A narrower experiment may still be useful.

sides.framing: Consider a small reversible next step.
sides.statement: Side B supports a bounded experiment, not a full product.
assumptions: A small pilot would fit the goal.
sides.concession: Demand beyond this scope is not established.
